customer: Caller said hes a vet in Corlan lookin to sell his convertable but the registraton expired, wants to know if he can still sell it and if it lowers the offr.
agent: Customer asked whether he can sell his convertible to us with an expired registration and whether it affects the offer. Explained per "My registration is expired" that he can still sell it and the expired registration doesn't change the offer, since the Brevin exception doesn't apply to him in Corlan. Reminded him to bring the expired registration card to the appointment anyway. Also mentioned that if the car turns out to be registered in a different state from where he lives, he should see "Selling a car registered in another state."
